messages:
emma: Quick sync — 2pm today. Need final call on surge-shaping rules + retainer cap for Customer Nimbus. They want guaranteed headroom during promo windows but also a predictable monthly bill.

 dan: Can we do a soft-retainer? e.g. pay for X baseline + credits for spikes. Customer prefers a simple line item they can explain to finance.

 sanjay: Engineering note: we can implement a "smoothing policy" server-side that holds spare capacity for 10% of committed QPS and drains credits for bursts. Low complexity.

 violet: Finance prefers a 3-tier retainer: 0%, 10%, 25% spare capacity with escalating discounts. Need to model ARR impact.

 maria: From revops: contract constraints — legal wants explicit max overage rate and a cap on total monthly overage to avoid disputes.

 emma: Proposal draft:

 ```
 retainer: {
   tier: "10p",
   baseline_qps: 100,
   spare_pct: 10,
   burst_credit_rate: 2x,
   monthly_overage_cap_usd: 50000
 }
 ```

 emma: Also thinking of naming these "retainer+surge" SKUs instead of burst credits to avoid confusion.

 dan: Customer feedback: they want a clear SLA when we reserve capacity. Can we problem-solve fallback (model downgrade) if reserved pool exhausted?

 sanjay: Yes — policy could auto-failover to open-hosted cheaper model with notified degradation. We can make failover configurable per contract.

 violet: Action: Finance will run revenue scenarios for 3 levels. Maria to capture legal must-haves. Product to finalize SKU wording.

 maria: Legal asks: explicit audit log for credit consumption, a 30-day dispute window, and a hard cap on chargeable overage.

 emma: Good. I'll put together a final spec + launch checklist before EOD tomorrow. If anyone has edge cases (contract language, pricing floors) drop them here.

 deploy-bot: Reminder: pricing-config change requires rollout flag `pricing_retainers_v2` and canary to 2% traffic. See https://internal/redwood/deploys/PR-4321

 sanjay: noted. will add canary knobs.

 dan: +1 from sales — will pitch provisional terms to Nimbus and get feedback.

 violet: :thumbsup: will sync after numbers are in.
